card.name: Partway through section-heading medical words
card.fires_on: Partway through a medical word that starts a new section or drug-class heading, such as Immunosuppress-ants, Embryo-Fetal Toxic-ity, Somnol-ence or drowsiness. It also fires on 'e' in 'e.g.' after a drug-class colon.

modes.label: Heading words split up
modes.description: A piece of a long medical term in a section or drug-class heading, just before the word ends.

modes.label: Embryo-Fetal Toxicity
modes.description: The word Toxic inside the heading Embryo-Fetal Toxicity.

modes.label: e.g. after drug class
modes.description: The letter e in e.g. following a drug class and colon, before example drugs.
modes.example: Narcotic analgesics metabolized by CYP3A:<< e>>.g., fentanyl, oxycod
